listing.name: Tom and Jerry in House Trap — TomJerryRecomp (IraFunesto)
listing.original_game_title: Tom and Jerry in House Trap
listing.summary: Experimental project. Title widescreen/split-screen/HUD/timing/loading fixes; no full completion proof. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European PAL SLES-03181 CUE/BIN. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the advertised ZIP with Python3 and open TomJerry_Recompiled.exe. Choose Generate & rebuild to compile your own disc locally. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project reports game-specific widescreen, split-screen, HUD, timing and loading fixes. Full completion has not been established. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
